REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
MONDAY - JULY 27, 2026 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
PUBLIC ADVISORY: THIS MEETING WILL BE CONDUCTED IN A HYBRID MODEL WITH BOTH IN-PERSON ATTENDANCE AND VIRTUAL PARTICIPATION.
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda packet is available at cerritos.gov and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st Floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours as posted. Materials received after posting of the agenda will also be available for public inspection. For assistance, contact the Office of the City Clerk at city_clerk@cerritos.gov or (562) 916-1248.
Order of Agenda
The City Council may reorder agenda items by majority vote of members present.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public may observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov/agendas or the City’s YouTube channel , on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public comment may be provided in person, remotely via Zoom, or in writing as described below. Public comment on business agenda items will be heard during consideration of that business item. Public comment on Consent Calendar, Closed Session, and non-agenda items will be heard during Agenda Item No. 6.
Remote/teleconference (Zoom) participation :
PLEASE ENSURE YOUR ZOOM SOFTWARE IS UPDATED TO PROVIDE LIVE COMMENTS
Meeting ID: 897 8691 1692
Smart Phone or Computer (Zoom App required): https://us02web.zoom.us/j/89786911692
Phone Call-In: (669) 900-6833
To request to speak via Zoom, to join or call in at the meeting start time and use the “Raise Hand” feature or press *9 by phone during the item on which you wish to speak. Press *6 to unmute when prompted.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Written comments may be submitted by email to city_clerk@cerritos.gov or delivered to the Office of the City Clerk no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. Timely comments will be distributed to the legislative body and retained as part of the official record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact City of Cerritos ADA/504 Coordinator, Drew Schneider, at (562) 916-1314 at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

11B.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Meeting Reports
During this part of the meeting members of the City Council report to the community on various matters of interest, including reports concerning committees on which the Councilmembers serve and reports on meetings/conferences attended. In addition, verbal reports will also be provided in such cases where the City Council-appointed delegate and/or alternate is unable to attend a scheduled meeting, and there is insufficient time to schedule an agenda item for Council consideration of another alternate, necessitating a Mayor's urgency appointment. Requests may also be made of staff for reports which will be presented to the City Council at a subsequent meeting, or for the scheduling of future agenda items. 6.  Public Comments and Suggestions (continued)

  Deborah Berry expressed concern regarding City Council administration of public
  comment periods.

  Charles Sooter spoke in support of the City’s recent budget study sessions and
  regarding the potential conduct of town hall meetings to increase transparency and
  improve communication between City officials and residents.

  Marty Powers expressed appreciation for the deferral of 2027 water and sewer rate
  adjustments to July 1, 2027 and spoke regarding options for prudent City fiscal
  administration.

  Case van der Linden expressed concern regarding unhoused individuals and matters
  of general community safety.

  Rocky Pavone expressed concern regarding several occurrences related to campaign
  activities occurring during previous City elections; public meeting and appointed
  officials administration; and City finances.

  Kirit Chauhan expressed concern regarding recent campaign activity related to local
  voter-initiated petitions in circulation and not yet filed.

  Raymond Kim spoke regarding business-owner rights related to trespassing on
  private property.

  Thomas Schwartz spoke in support of recent voter-initiated recall petition efforts and
  expressed concern regarding unhoused individuals residing in his neighborhood.

  Kurtis Forsythe expressed concern regarding alleged discrimination he has recently
  experienced during his interactions with City officials.

  received full-text, unredacted copies of the one (1) written comment submitted by
  the deadline for Item 6, for inclusion in the official record. Requests for copies of the
  written comments submitted for this meeting can be made during regular business
  hours to the Office of the City Clerk.
